q-173714.name: Question 1
q-173714.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $2$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}2(4p+2q)+5p & = \\ 2\cdot 4p+2\cdot 2q+5q & = \\ (8p)+(4q)+5q & = \\ 8p+4q+5q & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}8p+4q+5q & = \\ 8p+(4q+5q) & = \\ 8\,p+9\,q\end{aligned}
$$

q-109138.name: Question 2
q-109138.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $6$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-12u+6(v+2u) & = \\ -12u+6\cdot v+6\cdot 2u & = \\ -12u+(6v)+(12u) & = \\ -12u+6v+12u & \end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-12u+6v+12u & = \\ (12u-12u)+6v & = \\ 6v\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

q-141930.name: Question 3
q-141930.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $(-6)$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}6x+(3x+5)\cdot (-6) & = \\ 6x+3x\cdot (-6)+5\cdot (-6) & = \\ 6x+(-18x)+(-30) & = \\ 6x-18x-30\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

 

$$
\begin{aligned}6x-18x-30 & = \\ (6x-18x)-30 & = \\ -12x-30 & \end{aligned}
$$

q-178209.name: Question 4
q-178209.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $(-2)$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}8q+(6p+5q)\cdot (-2) & = \\ 8q+6p\cdot (-2)+5q\cdot (-2) & = \\ 8q+(-12p)+(-10q) & = \\ 8q-12p-10q\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}8q-12p-10q & = \\ (8q-10q)-12p & = \\ -2\,q-12\,p & \end{aligned}
$$

q-171506.worked_solution:

$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}30r-12s-11r & = \\ (30r-11r)-12s & = \\ 19\,r-12\,s\end{aligned}

q-178218.name: Question 6
q-178218.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $6$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}24+(2z-5)\cdot 6 & = \\ 24+2z\cdot 6+(-5)\cdot 6 & = \\ 24+(12z)+(-30) & = \\ 24+12z-30\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}24+12z-30 & = \\ 12z+(24-30) & = \\ 12\,z-6\end{aligned}
$$
